_comment: Approval routing (least-privilege lens: team/least-privilege/APPROVAL_ROUTING.md). Consumed by the approval flow / Function behind the workflows' approvalWebhookUrl. The flow receives the HttpWebhook subscribe body ({kind, reportType, requestedBy, correlationId, callbackUrl, ...}), evaluates rules in order, picks the first match, resolves the approver set (Graph group members minus exclusions), sends the Teams Approval, and POSTs {decision, approver, correlationId, tier, timestamp} to callbackUrl. It must verify approver ∈ resolved set using the approver's token UPN (Graph checkMemberGroups), never a free-text field. Decision values other than 'approved' / 'APPROVED' skip the submission (workflows/README.md).

requesterResolution.source: requestedBy field populated by the caller from the authenticated token claim (preferred: Logic Apps Request trigger OAuth policy, x-ms-client-principal-name); if absent the run is treated as scheduled (no human requester)

rules.rationale: Leaves the team (DPO, CISOs, contract owners): four-eyes, approver != author. EU AI Act Art. 14; ISO 27001 A.5.3
Internal working paper promoted to a stakeholder-facing deliverable at trigger time
Minimum that still puts a natural person between the verifier-passed draft and the SharePoint write; internal audience
Scheduled runs (onetrust-assessment-intake, scheduled-deepsearch) have no human author
Submissions into registers of record are human-accountable acts (DORA/NIS2 context in governance/HUMAN_APPROVAL.md)

rules.additionalConfirmation: methodology change confirmed by the requester when thresholds/scoring change (template-manager charter)
rules.rationale: Configuration of record; segregation of duties when the owner is the requester

rules.channel: GitHub PR review (CODEOWNERS) + deployment environment 'prod' approval
rules.rationale: Bicep, registry.json, OpenAPI specs, workflow definitions, agent instructions, persona, knowledge packs, Graph consents, privileged group membership

rules.skipWhen: requester is the note author (self-deletion needs no approval)
rules.rationale: Shared team memory is a RoPA-scoped store; deletion of another person's note is auditable

decisionRecord.retention: Logic Apps run history + Log Analytics export >= 1 year (DORA Art. 28)
